name: Swanson Triple Magnesium Complex Powder 400 mg 8 oz Pwdr
title: Swanson Triple Magnesium Complex Powder 400 mg 8 oz Pwdr
titleKa: Swanson Triple Magnesium Complex Powder 400 mg 8 oz Pwdr
title_en: Swanson Triple Magnesium Complex Powder 400 mg 8 oz Pwdr
description:
The list of benefits of magnesium keeps growing! Scientists now credit it with involvement in over 600 enzymatic reactions in the body. You may know it best as an essential mineral for bone health, or maybe you appreciate its calming effects on mind and body . Intakes of 300-500 mg per day may help promote healthy levels of cortisol, the stress hormone, by influencing the activity of the hypothalamic-pituitary axis. This multitasker doesn't stop there! It also plays an important role in function of the brain, heart and skeletal muscles , it is needed for cellular metabolism, energy production, metabolic functions, blood pressure maintenance, a healthy mood and even digestive function and comfort. Swanson Triple Magnesium Complex delivers all of this in an easy-mixing, unflavored powder to give a healthy boost to any beverage. Each scoop provides 400 mg of magnesium for nearly a full day's needs in one convenient serving. Our comprehensive blend includes magnesium from three distinct sources--magnesium oxide, aspartate and citrate--for improved absorbability.
Helps promote mental relaxation and supports a healthy response to daily stress

Essential for strong muscles, bones, cardiovascular and healthy digestive function

Helps reduce tiredness and fatigue

Gluten Free, Vegan, Vegetarian, Non-GMO
Per GMP guidelines set forth by the FDA, most products are formulated for 24 months from the date of manufacture. Liquids and probiotics are formulated for 12 months.

name: Swanson High Concentrate Omega-3 Fish Oil - 680 mg (120 Softgels)
title: Swanson High Concentrate Omega-3 Fish Oil - 680 mg (120 Softgels)
titleKa: Swanson High Concentrate Omega-3 Fish Oil - 680 mg (120 Softgels)
title_en: Swanson High Concentrate Omega-3 Fish Oil - 680 mg (120 Softgels)
description:
Give your heart, brain and joint health a boost with Swanson High Concentrate Omega-3 Fish Oil. Our molecularly distilled fish oil is derived from high quality ingredients and delivers the benefits of healthy omega-3 essential fatty acids (EFAs). With 720 mg of omega-3 fatty acids and 680 mg EPA + DHA (eicosapentaenoic acid and docosahexaenoic acid) per 2 mini softgels serving size, you'll get the important omega-3 EFAs you need to help support cardiovascular health, healthy cognitive function, joint health, heart health and more. Swanson High Concentrate Omega-3 Fish Oil is molecularly distilled, which means you get a pure form of fish oil with no fishy odor or aftertaste. Just 2 mini softgels provide more than 2x the standard serving of fish oil with EPA and DHA.
DELIVERS ESSENTIAL FATTY ACIDS: Swanson's mini fish oil softgels are full of EPA and DHA nutrients, which show promise for supporting heart health. DHA are also essential for aiding brain function and may support learning and memory.
JOINT and MOOD SUPPORT: Essential fatty acids from fish oil may promote mood and joint support as you age, skin health, and more. Enjoy 2x the standard serving of fish oil with no fishy aftertaste with Swanson Omega-3 Fish Oil Capsules.
DOSAGE INSTRUCTIONS: Our wellness supplements offer everyday solutions for an enhanced mind and body. Take two softgels per day with food and water. Consult your physician before using if you are pregnant, nursing, or taking other supplements.
OUR QUALITY COMMITMENT: For nearly 50 years, Swanson has delivered science-backed health products worldwide. Each wellness supplement is made in our GMP certified facilities, and our purity and potency testing includes independent third-party labs.

name: Swanson Highest Potency Vitamin D3 Softgels, 250 mg, 250 Sgels
title: Swanson Highest Potency Vitamin D3 Softgels, 250 mg, 250 Sgels
titleKa: Swanson Highest Potency Vitamin D3 Softgels, 250 mg, 250 Sgels
title_en: Swanson Highest Potency Vitamin D3 Softgels, 250 mg, 250 Sgels
description:
Adequate vitamin D, or the "sunshine vitamin," is essential for optimal health, but getting enough vitamin D from your diet or through sun exposure is difficult for many people. New research shows vitamin D also supports colon health. Taking Swanson's softgel vitamin D3, our most biologically active form of D3, is a great way to promote proper vitamin D levels and enhance calcium absorption. Additionally, our ability to produce vitamin D diminishes with age. According to the National Institutes of Health, most people in the United States consume less than recommended amounts of vitamin D.
SUPPORTS BONE & TEETH HEALTH: Swanson's highest potency vitamin D3 supports strong and healthy bones and teeth. Vitamin D manages how much calcium gets distributed to your blood, bones and digestive system. Plus, it aids calcium absorption into your bones to help support bone strength.
PROMOTES CALCIUM ABSORPTION: Vitamin D supports the immune, cardiovascular, and nervous system function. Immune cells throughout our bodies have receptors for vitamin D that support differentiation, activation and proliferation of these cells.
COMBATING D3 DEFICIENCY: There are many excellent food sources of vitamin D such as fish (salmon, sardines, mackerel, tuna, and cod liver oil). In addition, eggs, raw milk and mushrooms also contain vitamin D.
DOSAGE INSTRUCTIONS: As a dietary supplement, take one softgel per day with food and water.
